Rule: After a reset, no write of the Job of the old Game lands.

```mermaid
---
title: "A reset removes the Game and its holder in one hold"
---
sequenceDiagram
  participant You as Player
  participant C as GameCatalogue
  participant P as ActiveGame
  participant G as GameWriter
  participant J1 as Job 1
  participant L as LLM
  You->>G: send an Action
  Note over G: Job 1 holds Game 1
  J1->>G: save the Input, set the step
  J1->>L: narrator call
  You->>C: reset Game 1
  C->>P: take the lock of the pointer
  C->>G: create Game 2, remove Game 1
  Note over G: in one hold: Game 2 exists. Game 1 is gone, with no holder
  C->>P: make Game 2 active
  Note over P: Game 2 is active. The lock goes
  L-->>J1: the text
  J1-xG: save the text: refused, the holder is not Job 1
  Note over J1: Job 1 ends and writes nothing more
```
